description: An Ardia theme: colour roles that replace Ardia's own, per appearance, and the type, metrics, layout and icons it draws with

dark.description: Roles for the dark appearance; a role left out keeps Ardia's value

tabSelectedBorder.description: Two colours: the top and bottom of the border

light.description: Roles for the light appearance; a role left out keeps Ardia's value

tabSelectedBorder.description: Two colours: the top and bottom of the border

family.description: The interface font family, like "Avenir Next"; left out, the system font. A family macOS doesn't have falls back to the system font

mono.description: The monospaced family for codes, keys and logs

scale.description: Multiplies every text size, after sizes

caption.description: Captions, section labels, URLs under titles

body.description: Most text: menus, fields, folder and group names

title.description: Panel and dialog titles, the command bar's results

large.description: Large headings, the command bar's field

sizes.description: Text sizes in points, each replacing one step of Ardia's scale

medium.description: What medium text (group names, selected rows) draws with

semibold.description: What semibold text (headings, badges) draws with

weights.description: What each of Ardia's weight names draws with, from "100" (thin) to "900" (black)

rowHeight.description: Height of a sidebar row: tabs, folders, groups, the New Tab row and the sidebar address field

pinnedHeight.description: Height of a pinned tile in the sidebar's top apps grid

sidebarWidth.description: The sidebar's width. The sidebar takes it when you switch to the theme or change this value, and a double-click on its edge returns to it; left out, the width is yours (Ardia's default is 190)

row.description: Sidebar rows (tabs, folders, New Tab), the sidebar address field, top-strip tabs

pinned.description: Pinned tiles in the sidebar's top apps grid

tile.description: List rows, menu rows, fields, cards and icon tiles

sheet.description: Sheets, the tab switcher, search and other large panels

metrics.description: Sizes and corner radii, in points

hide.description: Parts of the sidebar to hide

addressField.description: Where the sidebar address field sits when the address bar is in the sidebar: top or bottom

newTab.description: Where the New Tab row sits: top or bottom of the tab list; left out, Settings › Tabs decides

layout.description: Which parts of the sidebar show, and where

icons.description: SF Symbols to draw in place of Ardia's, by name: { "plus": "plus.circle" }
